using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

using Jellyfin.Database.Implementations;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.FullSystemBackup;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.StorageHelpers;
using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.SystemBackupService;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Tests.FullSystemBackup
{
    public class BackupServiceTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<BackupService>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _mockDbProvider;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationHost> _mockApplicationHost;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _mockApplicationPaths;
        private readonly Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider> _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider;
        private readonly Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime> _mockHostApplicationLifetime;
        private readonly BackupService _backupService;

        public BackupServiceTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BackupService>>();
            _mockDbProvider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _mockApplicationHost = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();
            _mockApplicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            _mockHostApplicationLifetime = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();

            _backupService = new BackupService(
                _mockLogger.Object,
                _mockDbProvider.Object,
                _mockApplicationHost.Object,
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider.Object,
                _mockHostApplicationLifetime.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RestoreBackupAsync_DatabasePurgeCompletes_LogsDatabasePurgedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var archivePath = "test-backup.zip";
            var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>(new DbContextOptionsBuilder<JellyfinDbContext>().Options);
            var mockDbContext = dbContextMock.Object;
            
            _mockDbProvider
                .Setup(x => x.CreateDbContextAsync())
                .ReturnsAsync(mockDbContext);

            var mockHistoryRepository = new Mock<IHistoryRepository>();
            mockHistoryRepository.Setup(x => x.CreateIfNotExistsAsync()).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            mockHistoryRepository.Setup(x => x.GetAppliedMigrationsAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())).ReturnsAsync(new List<object>());
            
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.GetService<IHistoryRepository>()).Returns(mockHistoryRepository.Object);
            
            // Mock entity types with IQueryable properties
            var mockQueryableProperty = new Mock<PropertyInfo>();
            mockQueryableProperty.Setup(p => p.PropertyType).Returns(typeof(IQueryable<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(object)));
            mockQueryableProperty.Setup(p => p.GetValue(mockDbContext)).Returns((IQueryable)new Mock<IQueryable>().Object);
            
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.Model.FindEntityType(It.IsAny<Type>())).Returns((IEntityType)null!);
            
            _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider
                .Setup(x => x.PurgeDatabase(It.IsAny<JellyfinDbContext>(), It.IsAny<IEnumerable<string>>()))
                .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            // Setup ZipArchive mock - simplified for purge logging test
            var mockZipArchive = new Mock<ZipArchive>(new MemoryStream(), ZipArchiveMode.Read, false);
            var mockZipEntry = new Mock<ZipArchiveEntry>(mockZipArchive.Object, "manifest.json");
            mockZipEntry.Setup(x => x.OpenAsync()).ReturnsAsync(new MemoryStream());
            mockZipArchive.Setup(x => x.GetEntry(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockZipEntry.Object);

            // Mock File.OpenRead to return stream with ZipArchive
            var mockFileStream = new Mock<FileStream>(archivePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
            mockFileStream.Setup(x => x.DisposeAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);
            FileStream realFileStream = null;
            Mock.Get(realFileStream).Setup(x => x.DisposeAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);

            // Act
            await _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Database Purged")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RestoreBackupAsync_BeginsDatabasePurge_LogsBeginPurgingDatabaseMessage()
        {
            // Arrange - similar setup as above but verify the "Begin purging database" log
            var archivePath = "test-backup.zip";
            var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>(new DbContextOptionsBuilder<JellyfinDbContext>().Options);
            var mockDbContext = dbContextMock.Object;
            
            _mockDbProvider.Setup(x => x.CreateDbContextAsync()).ReturnsAsync(mockDbContext);
            
            var mockHistoryRepository = new Mock<IHistoryRepository>();
            mockHistoryRepository.Setup(x => x.CreateIfNotExistsAsync()).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            mockHistoryRepository.Setup(x => x.GetAppliedMigrationsAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())).ReturnsAsync(new List<object>());
            
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.GetService<IHistoryRepository>()).Returns(mockHistoryRepository.Object);
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.ChangeTracker).Returns(new Mock<ChangeTracker>().Object);
            
            _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider.Setup(x => x.PurgeDatabase(It.IsAny<JellyfinDbContext>(), It.IsAny<IEnumerable<string>>()))
                .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            // Act
            await _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath);

            // Assert - verify the specific log message at line ~200
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Begin purging database")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RestoreBackupAsync_NoHistoryData_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var archivePath = "test-backup.zip";
            
            // Setup to throw at history deserialization
            _mockDbProvider.Setup(x => x.CreateDbContextAsync()).ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Cannot restore backup that has no History data."));

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath));
        }
    }
}

        [Fact]

                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                        ((string)v).ToString().Contains("Database Purged")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RestoreBackupAsync_BeginsDatabaseRestore_LogsBeginRestoringDatabaseMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var archivePath = "test-backup.zip";
            SetupSuccessfulRestoreFlow(archivePath);

            // Act
            await _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath);

            // Assert - Verify the "Begin restoring Database" log
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                        ((string)v).ToString().Contains("Begin restoring Database")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private void SetupSuccessfulRestoreFlow(string archivePath)
        {
            var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>(new DbContextOptionsBuilder<JellyfinDbContext>().Options);
            var mockDbContext = dbContextMock.Object;

            _mockDbProvider.Setup(x => x.CreateDbContextAsync()).ReturnsAsync(mockDbContext);

            // Mock history repository
            var mockHistoryRepository = new Mock<IHistoryRepository>();
            mockHistoryRepository.Setup(x => x.CreateIfNotExistsAsync()).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            mockHistoryRepository.Setup(x => x.GetAppliedMigrationsAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync(new List<object>());
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.GetService<IHistoryRepository>()).Returns(mockHistoryRepository.Object);

            // Mock ChangeTracker
            var mockChangeTracker = new Mock<ChangeTracker>();
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.ChangeTracker).Returns(mockChangeTracker.Object);

            // Mock entity types discovery
            var mockQueryableProperty = new Mock<PropertyInfo>();
            mockQueryableProperty.Setup(p => p.PropertyType).Returns(typeof(IQueryable<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(object)));
            mockQueryableProperty.Setup(p => p.GetValue(mockDbContext)).Returns((IQueryable)new Mock<IQueryable>().Object);

            // Mock Model.FindEntityType to return table name
            dbContextMock.Setup(x => x.Model.FindEntityType(It.IsAny<Type>()))
                .Returns(new Mock<IEntityType>().Object);

            // Mock PurgeDatabase
            _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider.Setup(x => x.PurgeDatabase(It.IsAny<JellyfinDbContext>(), It.IsAny<IEnumerable<string>>()))
                .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            // Mock ZipArchive and entries
            var mockZipArchive = CreateMockZipArchive();
            SetupFileOpenReadToReturnZip(mockZipArchive.Object, archivePath);
        }

        private Mock<ZipArchive> CreateMockZipArchive()
        {
            var mockZipArchive = new Mock<ZipArchive>(new MemoryStream(), ZipArchiveMode.Read, false)
            {
                CallBase = true
            };

            // Mock manifest entry
            var mockManifestEntry = new Mock<ZipArchiveEntry>(mockZipArchive.Object, "manifest.json");
            mockManifestEntry.Protected().Setup<Task<Stream>>("OpenAsyncCore", It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
                .ReturnsAsync(new MemoryStream());
            mockZipArchive.Setup(x => x.GetEntry("manifest.json")).Returns(mockManifestEntry.Object);

            // Mock history entry
            var mockHistoryEntry = new Mock<ZipArchiveEntry>(mockZipArchive.Object, "Database/HistoryRow.json");
            mockHistoryEntry.Protected().Setup<Task<Stream>>("OpenAsyncCore", It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())
                .ReturnsAsync(new MemoryStream());
            mockZipArchive.Setup(x => x.GetEntry(It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("HistoryRow.json"))))
                .Returns(mockHistoryEntry.Object);

            return mockZipArchive;
        }

        private void SetupFileOpenReadToReturnZip(ZipArchive mockZipArchive, string archivePath)
        {
            var mockFileStream = new Mock<FileStream>(archivePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
            mockFileStream.Setup(x => x.DisposeAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);
            
            // Mock File.OpenRead static method using Moq's static mocking (requires Moq 4.20+)
            Mock.Get(File.OpenRead(archivePath)).Setup(x => x.DisposeAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);
        }
    }
